category_title: Students on the autism spectrum with perspective-taking challenges
scenario_title: Pretend physical dramatization with a peer
minimal_context: Karl and his peer James are standing in the middle of a circle using imaginary swords to act out a scene where Achilles strikes Moulios.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: James and Karl, let's show what 'Achilles struck Moulios on the head with his sword' might have looked like to the observing Greek and Trojan warriors. We're just going to pretend to fight to the death. But no actually touching. OK?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Agrees, pretends to wield an imaginary sword, and turns toward James) OK.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and start the scene.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Eyes James carefully, looking for a sneaky way to push his buttons before the strike) You're going down.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just focus on acting out the scene.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (As James lurches forward and cries out, 'I cut your head off!') No way! You can't just do that, I wasn't even ready and you stepped too fast, so technically that doesn't count at all!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: James and Karl, let's show what 'Achilles struck Moulios on the head with his sword' might have looked like to the observing Greek and Trojan warriors. We're just going to pretend to fight to the death. But no actually touching. OK?

TUTOR: Go ahead and start the scene.

STUDENT: (Eyes James carefully, looking for a sneaky way to push his buttons before the strike) You're going down.

TUTOR: Let's just focus on acting out the scene.

STUDENT: (As James lurches forward and cries out, 'I cut your head off!') No way! You can't just do that, I wasn't even ready and you stepped too fast, so technically that doesn't count at all!

task.content: Show what 'Achilles struck Moulios on the head with his sword' might have looked like to the observing Greek and Trojan warriors

context.environment: Standing in the middle of the circle
context.social_setting: With teacher Brian and peer James

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When peer James lurches forward and cries out, 'I cut your head off!'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Yells 'No way,' refusing to accept the peer's pretend action

behavior_patterns.condition: During general social interaction with peer James in the EBD unit
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Push each other's buttons; Karl acts sneakier but has it in for James
